headlines.description: — Kristaps Porzingis didn’t want to make predictions about how his body would respond heading into the NBA Finals after he spent more than a month on the sideline with a calf injury.
headlines.shortLinkText: Celtics rout Mavericks 107-89 in Game 1 of NBA Finals behind Brown, returning Porzingis

headlines.description: — Jrue Holiday led the scoring. Derrick White added a chase-down block. Jayson Tatum and Jaylen Brown pitched in, too — with their passing and defense.
headlines.shortLinkText: Celtics beat Mavericks 105-98, take 2-0 lead in NBA Finals as series heads to Dallas

headlines.description: — Jayson Tatum and Jaylen Brown shared a long hug after helping Boston avoid the biggest collapse in an NBA Finals game since at least 1997.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tatum, Brown help Celtics hold off huge Dallas rally for 106-99 win, 3-0 lead in NBA Finals

headlines.description: — There were two options for the Dallas Mavericks. Pack for Boston, or pack for vacation.
headlines.shortLinkText: Doncic scores 29, Mavericks roll past the Celtics 122-84 to avoid a sweep in the NBA Finals

headlines.description: — Jayson Tatum put his hands behind his head, with TD Garden fans standing on their feet cheering around him, and took it all in.
headlines.shortLinkText: Celtics win 18th NBA championship with 106-88 Game 5 victory over Dallas Mavericks
